_doc: FONT REGISTRY — how the engine references each font in a CapCut draft, keyed by font-file basename (what packbuild/cleanyap/superyap pass as font_path). VERIFIED from your 'Font Pack' + 'PackDemo-*' drafts 2026-08-03: the pack fonts are INSTALLED CapCut fonts (platform=0, no resource_id, path in the CapCut user Fonts folder) — they resolve by FILE. The engine copies the bundled assets/fonts/<file> into the buyer's CapCut Fonts dir at build (packbuild.capcut_font_path), so the buyer does nothing. They are NOT CapCut cloud-library fonts and have NO resource_id to capture. Only genuine CapCut cloud-library fonts (platform=1, e.g. ZY Modern) carry a resource_id, which the engine references so CapCut pulls them from its cloud. capcut_fonts.resolve() applies a resource_id when the entry has one; otherwise it's file-only (unchanged, OFL + installed fonts). The ONLY open font question is LICENSE: which non-OFL files may ship in the sold kit.

Prosecco.ttf.note: installed CapCut font, resolves by bundled file. (fonts.json also notes a cloud resource_id 7527220957073640720 if ever needed, but your drafts use the file.)

Bloop.ttf.note: installed CapCut font, resolves by bundled file. No cloud id.

SoupDuJour.ttf.note: SOLID Soup Du Jour, resolves by bundled file or by name from CapCut. Shares its CapCut display name with SoupDuJourHollow.ttf — disambiguate by FILE, not name.

SoupDuJourHollow.ttf.note: HOLLOW Soup Du Jour, same CapCut display name as SoupDuJour.ttf — disambiguate by FILE. On a buyer machine (both files excluded from ship) resolving by NAME can only return ONE 'Soup Du Jour'; the hollow effect then needs the buyer's CapCut to carry the hollow variant.

UglyDaveAlternates.otf.note: installed CapCut font, resolves by bundled file or by name from CapCut. No cloud id.

packs: (personal — your Super Yap takeover, not a ship pack)
ZY-Modern.ttf.note: genuine CapCut cloud-library font (platform=1, captured from your drafts). The engine references it by resource_id.
